peopleAlsoAsk.question: What are the benefits of encapsulated probiotics?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Encapsulation materials, such as polysaccharides, proteins, and lipids, play a vital role in determining the properties of the encapsulated probiotics. The benefits of encapsulated probiotics include improved gut health, enhanced immune system function, and increased tolerance to stress conditions.
